### Props

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                                                                                            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tile` | `{ title: string, icon: string, iconType: 'svg'&#124;'class'&#124;'url'&#124;'emoji', backgroundColor: string, textColor: string, linkType: 'app'&#124;'url'&#124;'route', linkValue: string }` | ✓        | —       | Tile configuration object. `linkType` decides how `linkValue` is followed: `app` builds a full-page `/apps/…` URL, `url` opens an external link, and `route` pushes `linkValue` through the host app's vue-router so SPA state (e.g. an in-memory vault key) survives the navigation. |
